trajectory.thought: The leader is the seeded median of the full 19-model pool, and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable. action_args.justification: The series is strongly trending and seasonal, non-stationary, with unstable model ranking (Kendall τ −0.115) and high cross-model error correlation (mean 0.86, only 3 independent groups). Under these conditions a robust median over the full 19-model pool is the natural choice: it preserves the diversity of approaches (tree-based, wavelet, ARIMA, ETS) without over-weighting any single model, and it is insensitive to the 2–3 worst performers. All smaller-pool baselines (top-5, top-7, top-9) scored worse, confirming that the full pool's breadth matters more than cherry-picking. The runner-up (plain mean) is statistically indistinguishable, and with only 3 validation windows any fitted-weighting scheme would be high-variance. The median is the most defensible combination for this series.
